elements.name: camera_table
elements.brief: Every live camera, keyed by the id of the game object it lives on. The
elements.description:
Every live camera, keyed by the id of the game object it lives on. The
shutter.script file writes to it; read from it rather than manipulating it
directly.

elements.name: center_behavior
elements.brief: Keeps the projection fixed and shrinks the viewport to preserve the display
elements.description:
Keeps the projection fixed and shrinks the viewport to preserve the display
ratio, letterboxing or pillarboxing the remainder.

elements.name: expand_behavior
elements.brief: Keeps the viewport filling the window and widens the projection as the window
elements.description:
Keeps the viewport filling the window and widens the projection as the window
grows, showing more of the game world rather than scaling it.

elements.name: stretch_behavior
elements.brief: Keeps both the viewport and the projection filling the window, so the game world
elements.description:
Keeps both the viewport and the projection filling the window, so the game world
distorts with the window ratio.

elements.name: activate
elements.brief: Installs a camera's viewport, view matrix and projection matrix into the render
elements.description:
Installs a camera's viewport, view matrix and projection matrix into the render
context. Call it from a render script before drawing the world.

parameters.name: object
parameters.doc: The game object the camera lives on.

returnvalues.doc: The camera's frustum, for passing to `render.draw`.

elements.name: deactivate
elements.brief: Restores the viewport and matrices Defold's GUI system expects, sized to the
elements.description:
Restores the viewport and matrices Defold's GUI system expects, sized to the
current window. Call it before drawing GUI.

returnvalues.doc: The frustum matching the restored matrices.

elements.name: force_update
elements.brief: Recalculates a camera's viewport, view matrix and projection matrix immediately.
elements.description:
Recalculates a camera's viewport, view matrix and projection matrix immediately.
The shutter.script game object already does this once per frame; call it directly
only after changing a camera property mid-frame.

parameters.name: object
parameters.doc: The game object the camera lives on.

elements.name: get_viewport
elements.brief: Calculates the camera's viewport in window coordinates, scaled from the
elements.description:
Calculates the camera's viewport in window coordinates, scaled from the
game.project display size and, under center behavior, shrunk and centered to
preserve the display ratio.

parameters.name: object
parameters.doc: The game object the camera lives on.

returnvalues.doc: The viewport's x, y, width and height.

elements.name: get_view
elements.brief: Calculates the camera's view matrix from the inverse of its game object's world
elements.description:
Calculates the camera's view matrix from the inverse of its game object's world
transform.

parameters.name: object
parameters.doc: The game object the camera lives on.

elements.name: get_projection
elements.brief: Calculates the camera's orthographic projection matrix, sized from the display
elements.description:
Calculates the camera's orthographic projection matrix, sized from the display
under center and stretch behavior and from the window under expand behavior.

parameters.name: object
parameters.doc: The game object the camera lives on.

elements.name: get_frustum
elements.brief: Returns the camera's frustum, the product of its last calculated projection and
elements.description:
Returns the camera's frustum, the product of its last calculated projection and
view matrices.

parameters.name: object
parameters.doc: The game object the camera lives on.

elements.name: get_distance
elements.brief: Converts a screen distance into the world distance an object must travel to cover
elements.description:
Converts a screen distance into the world distance an object must travel to cover
it, accounting for the camera's zoom and, under center and stretch behavior, for
the viewport no longer mapping to physical screen coordinates.

parameters.name: object
parameters.doc: The game object the camera lives on.

parameters.name: distance
parameters.doc: The screen distance to convert.

parameters.name: absolute
parameters.doc: Skip rotating the result by the camera's rotation.

elements.name: shake
elements.brief: Starts a camera shake animation, cancelling and restarting any shake already
elements.description:
Starts a camera shake animation, cancelling and restarting any shake already
running on this camera.

parameters.name: object
parameters.doc: The game object the camera lives on.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.doc: Shake the camera object's parent instead of the camera itself.

parameters.name: count
parameters.doc: How many times to displace the camera before stopping.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.doc: Seconds each displacement takes.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.doc: How far each displacement moves the camera.

parameters.name: duration_scalar
parameters.doc: Multiplies the duration after each displacement. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: radius_scalar
parameters.doc: Multiplies the radius after each displacement. Defaults to 1.

elements.name: cancel_shake
elements.brief: Stops a running camera shake and returns the shaken object to where it started.
elements.description:
Stops a running camera shake and returns the shaken object to where it started.
Does nothing if no shake is running.

parameters.name: object
parameters.doc: The game object the camera lives on.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.doc: Whether the shake was started against the camera object's parent.

elements.name: screen_to_world
elements.brief: Converts a screen position to its world position through the inverse of the
elements.description:
Converts a screen position to its world position through the inverse of the
camera's frustum.

parameters.name: object
parameters.doc: The game object the camera lives on.

parameters.name: x
parameters.doc: The screen position's x coordinate.

parameters.name: y
parameters.doc: The screen position's y coordinate.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.doc: Return `nil` instead when the position falls outside the camera's view.

returnvalues.doc: The world position, or `nil` if `visible` filtered it out.

elements.name: world_to_screen
elements.brief: Converts a world position to its screen position through the camera's frustum.
elements.description: Converts a world position to its screen position through the camera's frustum.

parameters.name: object
parameters.doc: The game object the camera lives on.

parameters.name: position
parameters.doc: The world position to convert.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.doc: Return `nil` instead when the position falls outside the camera's view.

returnvalues.doc: The screen position, or `nil` if `visible` filtered it out.

properties.name: viewport_x_adjusted
properties.brief: Viewport left edge after the window scale and any letterboxing margin.
properties.description: Viewport left edge after the window scale and any letterboxing margin.

properties.name: viewport_y_adjusted
properties.brief: Viewport bottom edge after the window scale and any pillarboxing margin.
properties.description: Viewport bottom edge after the window scale and any pillarboxing margin.

properties.name: shake_origin
properties.brief: Where the shaken object sat before the shake began, and `nil` while no shake
properties.description:
Where the shaken object sat before the shake began, and `nil` while no shake
is running. `cancel_shake` restores the object to it.
